phase.title: Phase 2 — language layer & formats
phase.intro: The scaffold, the Aurora component library and the locale pipeline are in place: the middleware resolves the language from the URL prefix or the NEXT_LOCALE cookie, the dictionary covers every visible string, and numbers/dates come from one formatting layer (Persian digits and the Jalali calendar in Farsi).
phase.nextUp: Next: Phase 3 — mock data (tokens, pools, proposals), zustand stores and the wallet connection (MetaMask or the demo chain).

format.heading: Format & locale
format.intro: One value, both locales. English is rendered with Latin digits; Farsi uses Persian digits, Persian thousands separators and the Jalali (Shomalī) calendar. Prices, addresses and hashes always stay Latin — that is a contract, not a leftover.
format.note: The middleware resolved this page from the locale prefix / NEXT_LOCALE cookie. Numbers and dates follow the locale; prices and addresses stay Latin.
